selection.name: Mana Break
selection.description: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt. Enemies with no mana left are temporarily slowed.
values: MOVE SPEED SLOW ON FULL DRAIN: 25% / 30% / 40%
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Automatically casts Mana Void if the target is out of mana. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

selection.name: Mana Drain
selection.description: CHANNELED - Absorbs the magical energies of a target enemy unit by taking mana from it every second.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Grants spell immunity while channelling. Mana drained is distributed to allies within 900 unit radius from the caster.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Mana Drain deals damage and targets 2 more units.

selection.name: Mana Shield
selection.description: Creates a shield that absorbs 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% of incoming damage in exchange for the hero's mana. Provides bonus mana capacity.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: When the hero spends 500 of their mana on Mana Shield, it automatically casts a Mystic Snake (8% mana steal) on the last unit that damaged this hero.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Mystic Snake petrifies for 1 seconds. Targets affected are stunned and take 50% extra physical damage for the duration of the debuff.

selection.name: Meat Hook
selection.description: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Units hit are max level Ruptured during hook.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Launches two extra hooks to either side of the main one.

selection.name: Mirror Image
selection.description: Creates multiple images of the caster under their control.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +25 agility. Reduces cooldown by 10, and increases outgoing damage by 13%.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Riptide: every 6 attacks (including illusions), the caster and their images will hit all nearby units with a 55 damage wave that lowers armor by 8 for 4 seconds. Increases illusion count by 1.
